deviations: Probit marginal effects are computed as average marginal effects (mean of phi(xb) times beta); the paper does not say whether its marginal effects are averaged or taken at the means.
notes: attempt-1 was exploratory: it listed the variables and labels in data/final-data.dta and printed no RESULT lines. The final script uses data/final-data.dta only. Samples come from the built-in flags: base_sample==1 (N=644) for columns 1-5, and marital_rates_sample==1 (N=765) for column 6. The landholdings columns use the observations where fmissmatch, fmissmatch2 or fdown are not missing (N=324). Panel B adds distlondon, which drops women without a recorded seat (N=484 and 260). Treatment is syntheticT. Controls are pr4 (duke/marquess/earl daughter), hengpee (English peerage) and biorder (birth order excluding heirs). Outcomes: cOut, mheir, fmissmatch (absolute difference), fmissmatch2 (husband minus wife), fdown, and celibacy (never married). Columns 1, 2, 5 and 6 are probits with average marginal effects; columns 3 and 4 are OLS. Standard errors are clustered by birth year (byear). The bootstrap-t p-values were not reproduced because they are not claimed. No claim-comparison iterations were needed. All 13 values match the paper at its reported precision, and the printed standard errors and dependent-variable means also match Table 2.
